clips.send: GDP per person. Total value of final goods and services divided by population. The most common yardstick for a country’s standard of living. Growth comes from more output per worker (productivity), not just more workers. Real GDP removes inflation so you compare actual stuff produced.
clips.text: GDP per person. Total value of final goods and services ÷ population. The most common yardstick for a country’s standard of living. Growth comes from more output per worker (productivity), not just more workers. Real GDP removes inflation so you compare actual stuff produced.

clips.send: Capital goods. Things made to make other things: tools, machines, factories. A welding robot, a tractor, a delivery truck, a computer used at work. More and better capital per worker raises output per worker. Diminishing returns: each extra machine adds a little less.

clips.send: Labor and human capital. People’s work — and the skills and knowledge they bring. Human capital equals education, training, experience and health. More skill means more output from the same hours of work. Literacy is the first step: workers who read can learn new tools.

clips.send: Entrepreneurship. Combining the other factors and taking the risk of a new business. Entrepreneurs spot a need, organize resources and risk their own money. The profit motive rewards them if customers want what they make. Georgia examples: Coca-Cola began in an Atlanta pharmacy in 1886; Chick-fil-A grew from a Hapeville diner.

clips.send: Land and natural resources. Gifts of nature: land, water, minerals, oil, forests. Includes the site of a factory and the raw materials it uses. Unevenly spread: Saudi Arabia has oil, Japan has very little of anything. Resources help, but countries with few (Japan, South Korea) can still grow rich through skills and capital.

clips.send: 劳动与人力资本。人们的劳动，以及他们的技能和知识。 人力资本 等于 教育、培训、经验和健康。 技能越高，同样的工作时间产出越多。 识字是第一步：会读书的工人才能学会新工具。

clips.send: 土地与自然资源。大自然的馈赠：土地、水、矿产、石油、森林。 包括工厂的用地和所用的原材料。 分布不均：沙特阿拉伯有石油，日本几乎什么资源都少。 资源有帮助，但资源少的国家（日本、韩国）也能靠技能和资本富起来。
